claim: Permission sets are a collection of permissions that you create in IAM Identity Center, modelled on AWS managed policies for job functions or any AWS managed policies, and you can also fully customize them; IAM Identity Center applies these permissions to the selected accounts automatically.

evidence.quote: Permission sets are a collection of permissions that you can create in IAM Identity Center, modelling them based on AWS managed policies for job functions or any AWS managed policies.
If required, you can also fully customize the permission set to meet your security requirements.
IAM Identity Center applies these permissions to the selected accounts automatically.
